thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from the security postmortem—root cause was a combination of stale token validation schema (service-x still accepting old tokens) + an RBAC gap that allowed a downstream service to escalate. I'm collecting remediation owners and timelines here. Please confirm ownership and an ETA. TL;DR: rotate secrets, tighten permissions, enable audit logging for service-x, add token-validation CI check, and schedule recurring permission audits.

adrian: I can own the audit logging enablement. I'll open the infra PR today and aim to have ACLs and log shipping verified by Tue. PR: https://git.internal/r/adrian/enable-service-x-logs (WIP). I'll also add a Kibana dashboard for failed token validations. :thumbsup:

sophie: Will take permissions hardening. My plan: add missing deny rules + add unit tests around permission matrix. Need 2 days to do the initial change and then a canary rollout. Will coordinate with oncall for the canary window.

raj: I can own secrets rotation automation. Proposal: add a scheduled rotation job in Vault that triggers for service-x keys and a one-time manual rotation today. Quick command I ran locally: 
```
vault write auth/rotate service-x
```
Cron suggestion for rotation: `0 3 * * 1` (weekly) — we can make it monthly if ops prefers. I'll put up a small operator playbook for emergency manual rotation.

emily: I'll update the runbook and add the postmortem action items to the incident tracker. Suggest we include a smoke test step: call token validation endpoint with a suite of synthetic tokens to assert schema validation. Also recommend adding an automatic alert when token-validation error rate > 0.5% over 5m.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Planned deployment to enable logging in staging scheduled for 1749504000. Will post status on completion.

security-bot: ticket-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026 with linked tasks [audit-logs, perms, rotation, CI-check]. Assignee: TBD.

leo: One thing to flag — we've seen a similar pattern twice in the last quarter where token schema drift + permissive default rules caused incidents (see incidents: 1712100000, 1718000000). We should consider adding a CI gate that validates token schema compatibility during model/service changes. Also proposing a monthly permission sweep automation to surface overly-broad roles.

adrian: Adding the CI validation is low friction. I'll prototype a GitHub Action that runs a quick token schema check against the service contract; aim to have a draft by Friday.

sophie: For perms sweep, I'll draft a query that lists roles with > X broad permissions and mark candidates for review. ETA: next Wed for an initial report.

maya: Thanks all. I'll consolidate into the postmortem tracker: 1) Audit logs enablement — owner: adrian — ETA: Tue; 2) Permissions hardening + perms sweep — owner: sophie — ETA: next Wed (sweep) then rolling changes; 3) Secrets rotation automation + emergency playbook — owner: raj — ETA: today for manual, automation by next Mon; 4) Token-validation CI check — owner: adrian — ETA: Fri; 5) Runbook updates + smoke tests — owner: emily — ETA: Fri; 6) Add dashboard & alerts — owner: adrian — ETA: Tue. Please update the tracker rows with PR links and any blockers. We'll do a brief sync Friday 10am to confirm progress.

raj: Manual rotation completed — notes in SEC-2026. Automation job PR: https://git.internal/r/raj/rotate-service-x. Request review from @sophie and @adrian.

adrian: Reviewing now. Found small issue with log retention config, fixing in PR.

sophie: Reviewing rotation PR for permission side-effects. Also pushed a draft perms-sweep query to infra-utils.

emily: Runbook updated and smoke tests added (https://playbooks.internal/runbooks/service-x). Wrote a small harness to run synthetic tokens via `curl` with example payloads.

leo: +1 on CI gate. Also filing a follow-up epic to track monthly permission sweeps and token-compat tests across services — will link to SEC-2026.

maya: Great progress. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here. Otherwise I'll close the follow-up loop after the Friday sync and mark actions with their PRs/ticket links. :white_check_mark:
